claim: The MCP call_graph tool returns all 5 toolchain-derived direct-call edges for the committed stripped ELF.
detail: The MCP call_graph tool returns all 5 direct-call edges derived from the committed unstripped toolchain twin. The test computes the false-negative set and requires it to be empty. This small fixture does not establish the same rate for other binaries, architectures, or toolchains.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-mcp/tests/mcp_protocol_roundtrip.rs, navigation_tools_round_trip_a_committed_stripped_elf_over_stdio; ground truth comes from the committed unstripped toolchain twin

oracle.external: caller and callee addresses from the committed unstripped toolchain twin, compared with the MCP server's stdio response for the stripped subject
oracle.note: This claim covers one committed ELF pair and does not establish recall for other binaries, architectures, or toolchains.

title: MCP direct-call edge recall on a committed stripped ELF
